packageRules.description: automerge minor, patch and digest once every status check is green; majors are always reviewed

automerged updates wait 3 days, so a broken or compromised upstream release is not merged minutes after publication; digests are left out because most carry no release timestamp, and timestamp-optional keeps updates without one from being held forever
chezmoi externals are reviewed: the checksum commit comes from the validate workflow, which GitHub doesn't run checks for again

customManagers.description: GitHub release downloads pinned in .chezmoiexternal.toml, checksums are fixed by the validate workflow
